title: Standing-Benefit Allowance on Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursements (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
A standing allowance is added to the Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs for the benefit entries standing on the program, counted as benefit entries less benefit reversals: **7 or more** add **150.00 dollars**, **4 to 6** add **75.00 dollars**, and fewer add nothing.

| Standing benefit entries on the card | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | $150.00 |
| 4 to 6 | $75.00 |
| 3 or fewer | $0.00 |

Every benefit entry on the card's activity is counted and each benefit reversal is taken off.

**Hypothetical card activity.**

- 8 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 7 standing, $150.00 added.
- 7 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 6 standing, $75.00 added.
- 4 benefit entries, 1 reversed: 3 standing, nothing added.
